biw_news.title: Mahindra Thar Roxx Integrates Advanced DaVinci Suspension Hardpoints
biw_news.summary: Recent spy shots confirm the implementation of specialized DaVinci suspension upgrades on the Thar Roxx. These geometric modifications to the chassis hardpoints aim to improve structural articulation and load distribution under high-stress off-road cycles.

biw_news.title: Volkswagen Unveils ID. Tiguan Architecture with Optimized Battery Structural Enclosures
biw_news.summary: The new ID. Tiguan showcases an integrated 77 kWh skateboard platform architecture. The battery pack enclosure functions as a primary structural member, significantly enhancing torsional rigidity and side-impact crashworthiness.

biw_news.title: Porsche Teases Mid-Engine Mission S Architecture and Lightweight Spaceframe
biw_news.summary: Porsche's upcoming Mission S concept previews a dedicated multi-material spaceframe layout positioned above the 911. The chassis leverages high-strength aluminum extrusions and carbon-fiber-reinforced polymers (CFRP) to optimize power-to-weight ratios and structural integrity.

biw_news.title: BMW Expands Neue Klasse Scalable EV Chassis Architecture to the iX4
biw_news.summary: The BMW iX4 utilizes the modular Neue Klasse skateboard architecture, prioritizing highly integrated battery-to-chassis load paths. This structural philosophy maximizes cabin packaging while maintaining exceptional torsional stiffness across the floorpan.

biw_news.title: Jaguar Type 01 Introduces High-Performance Monocoque Platform Layout
biw_news.summary: Jaguar's revival model debuts a bespoke EV monocoque designed to manage an output exceeding 1,000 horsepower. The underbody structure incorporates heavy-duty crash members and advanced load-bearing members tailored for extreme longitudinal acceleration.

biw_news.title: Bentley Torcal Adopts Rigid EV Platform Architecture for Luxury Segment
biw_news.summary: The Bentley Torcal introduces a heavy-duty electric platform engineered to support dual-motor high-torque configurations. The chassis architecture employs extensive use of hot-formed steels and structural adhesives to isolate NVH while meeting rigorous crash deformation standards.
